topic.title: 1.2 Lists
topic.shortdesc: DITA supports multiple list types for organizing information hierarchically.

body.p: Lists are essential for presenting structured information. This section covers the three main list types in DITA.

section.title: When to Use Lists
section.p: Choose the appropriate list type based on your content:

ul.li: Unordered lists for items with no specific sequence
Ordered lists for sequential steps or ranked items

ol.li: Keep list items parallel in structure
Limit list depth to maintain readability
Introduce lists with a complete sentence
